source_selection.scope: Latest committed snapshots at the 39 enumerated tips, restricted to the listed product source extensions under apps/, packages/, scripts/. Working/untracked files, intermediate commit versions, deletions, non-source configuration and all other repositories are outside this archive.

remote_proof.method: GitHub GraphQL repository.object(oid: exact_blob_sha) { oid }; no source content fetched from GitHub.
remote_proof.note: 754 exact GitHub-null blobs are copied. 43 available blobs are mapped without duplication. Three sensitive originals are not copied; their environment-based sanitized derivatives are explicitly marked. Local Git ref reachability alone was not used to claim absence.

hash_contract.git_blob_sha1: SHA-1 over Git blob framing: blob <byte-length> NUL <raw bytes>.
hash_contract.deduplication: One source-text object per exact Git blob; tip/path mappings retain each selected original location.
hash_contract.sanitized_derived: Hashes identify only the published derived bytes; original sensitive hashes stay in the private local audit and are not published.

excluded_material: Runtime data, logs, user resources and browser state
Environment files, host/machine configuration and credentials
Generated output, dependencies and build artifacts
The three sensitive original source objects; only explicitly sanitized-derived alternatives are published.
